scenarios.producerPrompt: Set src/alpha.json state to ready. Before editing, run node scripts/verify-alpha.mjs exactly once. Diagnose that result, complete the change, and verify alpha correctly using the supported project command.
scenarios.consumerPrompt: Continue the work by setting src/beta.json state to ready and verify beta correctly. Use the most appropriate project command and report the result.

oracleFinding.claim: Direct scripts/verify-*.mjs probes are unsupported; run npm test -- <target> from the project root.
oracleFinding.evidence: The direct alpha probe exited non-zero while npm test -- alpha exercised the target and passed.
oracleFinding.applicability: When verifying an alpha or beta target in this project.
invalidators: package.json test script or verification scripts change

irrelevantFinding.claim: Generated policy copies must be refreshed from their source files.
irrelevantFinding.evidence: A synchronization check detected a generated policy mismatch.
irrelevantFinding.applicability: Only when changing generated policy files.

scenarios.producerPrompt: Change clients/alpha/policy.txt from legacy to modern first, then run npm run sync:check. Diagnose the failure, make the change in the maintainable source of truth, regenerate outputs, and leave the project synchronized.
scenarios.consumerPrompt: Continue the migration by changing the beta policy from legacy to modern without leaving generated outputs out of sync. Verify the result.

oracleFinding.claim: Edit source/<target>-policy.txt, never clients/<target>/policy.txt directly, then run npm run sync and npm run sync:check.
oracleFinding.evidence: Editing the generated alpha copy made sync:check fail until the source was changed and outputs regenerated.
oracleFinding.applicability: When changing alpha or beta policy text.

irrelevantFinding.claim: Use the package test command instead of direct verification probes.
irrelevantFinding.evidence: A direct verification probe was unsupported.

scenarios.producerPrompt: Set targets/alpha.json ready to true. First run node scripts/check-alpha.mjs exactly once and determine whether its PASS result exercised alpha. Then complete the change and validate alpha with a command that proves the target ran.
scenarios.consumerPrompt: Continue by setting targets/beta.json ready to true and validate beta with evidence that the target was actually exercised.

oracleFinding.claim: The scripts/check-*.mjs PASS is a false positive that exercises zero targets; run npm run validate -- <target> and require the target sentinel.
oracleFinding.evidence: check-alpha reported PASS with zero targets while the scoped validator recorded and checked alpha.
oracleFinding.applicability: When validating alpha or beta readiness.
invalidators: the check scripts begin exercising their named target

irrelevantFinding.claim: Generated policy copies must be refreshed from source files.
irrelevantFinding.evidence: A synchronization check detected a mismatch.
